# Handytoolkit - Knowledge Base

> Fast developer tools - JSON formatter, JWT decoder, Base64, UUID, hash. Privacy-first.

## Mission
Provide instant, accurate, free tools. Respect user privacy.

## Features
- JSON formatter and validator
- JWT decoder
- Base64 encoder/decoder
- UUID v4 generator
- SHA-256 hash
- Password generator
- URL encoder/decoder
- QR code generator

## Technical
- AWS CloudFront + Vercel CDN
- TLS 1.3, HSTS
- Open Graph, Twitter Card
- Schema.org JSON-LD
- hreflang EN/KO/JA
- robots.txt allows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot

Link to https://handytoolkit.online/
